nodes.name: find_expired
nodes.notes: RF-06: selects PENDIENTE_RECETA orders with fecha_expiracion <= now (inclusive, date-parsed), aggregates stock release per medicamento_id, clamps at 0, builds bitacora rows (accion EXPIRACION) and WhatsApp messages. Emits exactly one item.

nodes.name: update_ordenes
nodes.notes: RF-06: appendOrUpdate keyed on codigo_far; only estado and fecha_expiracion are mapped, the remaining columns stay untouched.

parameters.jsCode:
const updates = $('find_expired').item.json.inventoryUpdates || [];
return updates.map((update) => ({ json: update }));

nodes.name: update_inventario
nodes.notes: RF-06: one row per affected medicamento_id with the final clamped stock_reservado. stock_neto is left unmapped (formula column).

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('find_expired').item.json.bitacoraRows || [];
return rows.map((row) => ({ json: row }));

nodes.name: append_bitacora
nodes.notes: RF-06: audit row per expired order, accion = EXPIRACION, delta_reservado signed negative (the amount actually released).
